# StreamDek Mobile v2.2.1

Search that tells you where each result comes from, Plex and Jellyfin pages you can arrange the way
you like, and a few tidier corners of the player and Settings.

## What's New

**Search, sorted by source**
Results now come in one section per place they were found: each of your Plex servers, each Jellyfin
server, StreamDek's catalogue, each add-on and each plugin. Every section is headed with its name,
what kind of source it is and how many results it found, and Plex and Jellyfin carry their own marks.
- Long sections fold to two rows, with **Show all** to see the rest and **Show less** to fold them
  again, so one busy source never pushes the others off the screen.
- A title found in several places is offered from each, so you can choose which one to play.

**Arrange your servers**
With more than one Plex or Jellyfin server, Settings > Sources > Plex or Jellyfin has arrows beside
each server. Move your favourite to the top and it leads the Plex or Jellyfin page too.

**Arrange your libraries**
Each library in a server's list now has a drag handle. Hold it and drag the library up or down to
choose where its rows appear on the Plex or Jellyfin page - Recently Added, the library itself,
Recently Watched and Collections move together.
- Each server keeps its own order.
- A library you switch off keeps its place for when you switch it back on.
- The page rearranges itself straight away, with nothing to reload.

**Know which server you are browsing**
With more than one server, each server's rows on the Plex and Jellyfin pages now begin with a clear
heading in the service's colour: its mark, its name and how many rows follow. As you scroll through
a server's rows, its name stays pinned just under the Plex / Jellyfin switch, and changes as the next
server's rows reach the top.

**Support StreamDek**
A **Donate on Ko-fi** link now sits at the foot of Settings, below Discord and Telegram.

## Improvements

**More accurate Plex and Jellyfin search**
Your server's results now only include titles that actually match what you typed. Plex also returns
titles linked to your search through an actor, a genre or what it considers related, and those used
to appear as matches - searching "Euphoria" could list Tracker, Supergirl and Hoppers. Matching
ignores capitals, accents and punctuation, so "amelie" finds "Amélie" and "spiderman" finds
"Spider-Man", and one typo in a longer word is forgiven.

**Reaching a Plex server at home**
Some routers block the secure address Plex gives for your home network, which could leave a server
in the same room unreachable. StreamDek now also tries the server's plain local address on your home
network when the secure one cannot be reached.

**The right Jellyfin account name**
With several Jellyfin servers, "Connected as" now shows your account on the server at the top of
your list, rather than always the same one.

**Shorter season button**
On a series page, "Mark Season as Watched" is now **Mark S1 as Watched** (or Unwatched), naming the
season you are on and taking far less room. Screen readers still hear the season in full.

**Cleaner stream cards**
A stream's size and its "ready" badge now share the card's top corner neatly, and the release text
beside them no longer runs underneath either one.

**A cleaner player**
The menu bar in the player's regular layout no longer has an outline around it.

## Quick Setup

- **Arrange servers:** Settings > Sources > Plex or Jellyfin, then use the arrows beside a server.
- **Arrange libraries:** open a server in the same place, then drag a library by its handle.
- **Search:** nothing to set up. Tap **Show all** on a section to see everything it found.

## Good to Know

- Server and library order are saved on this device, for the profile you are using. They do not yet
  carry over to your other devices or your TV.
- If your Plex server's **Secure connections** setting is **Required**, it will not accept the plain
  local address; set it to **Preferred** if your router blocks Plex's secure address.
- A title in your Plex library that only matches your search by its cast or genre no longer appears
  under Plex in Search. Search by its title to find it.
